Security & control

Confidence starts
with clear boundaries.

Intelligent assistance should support your decisions. Sensitive business actions need human oversight.

Business controls

Confirmation before action.

Bizzy helps prepare actions. Financial and business-changing actions require confirmation before completion.

Careful accounting records.

Review accounting adjustments and detailed records before confirming changes. Your bookkeeper or accountant can use the professional accounting tools available in your plan.

Review uncertain information.

AI-assisted extraction and product recognition need human review when details are uncertain.

Application security overview

The transactional application is separate from this public website. The current application uses password hashing and checks signed-in sessions, company membership and permissions. Stored documents are accessed through company and feature checks. These are implementation safeguards, not a guarantee that information can never be compromised. Operating configuration, provider arrangements and retention still require review.

Your information on this website

This website has no advertising trackers, analytics scripts or third-party fonts. The enquiry form is not connected to a submission service. It does not transmit or persist the details you enter.

Your data and AI assistance

Your business information is yours to manage. Important financial changes require approval; recording a payment does not transfer money. Read AI & Data Use for the information AI may process, and the Privacy Policy draft for topics still requiring legal review.

Before public launch

HTTPS, approved contact handling and reviewed privacy information are launch requirements. This local preview is not a security certification or a promise of regulatory compliance.
